topics.title: Whole Numbers - Identification and Reading of Number 6 - 9 and 9 - 6 Primary 1 (Basic 1) - Mathematics
topics.content:
MATHEMATICS
FIRST TERM
WEEK 5
PRIMARY 1
THEME - NUMBER AND NUMERATION
PREVIOUS LESSON - Whole Number 0 (Zero) - Introducing Zero (0) As A Number (Primary 1)
TOPIC - IDENTIFICATION AND READING OF NUMBER OF OBJECTS 6 - 9
LEARNING AREA
1. Introductory Activities
2. Sort and Classify Numbers of Objects in a Group or Collection
2. Counting Number 1 - 9
3. Read and Write Number 1 - 9
4. Arrange the number 1 - 9
PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES
By the end of the lesson, most of the pupils should have attained the following objectives -
1. sort and classify numbers of objects in a group or collection.
2. identify number of objects in a group or collection.
3. count and read correctly from 1 - 9.
4. write correctly number 6 - 9.
5. arrange the numbers 6 - 9 in order of their magnitudes (quantities).
ENTRY BEHAVIOUR
Counting and reading of numbers.
INSTRUCTIONAL MATERIALS
The teacher will teach the lesson with the aid of counters such as
1. Counters: balls, pebbles, buttons, bottle tops, leaves and oranges etc.
2. Flash cards of numbers 1 - 9, etc.
METHOD OF TEACHING
Choose a suitable and appropriate methods for the lessons.
Note - Irrespective of choosing methods of teaching, always introduce an activities that will arouse pupil’s interest or lead them to the lessons.
REFERENCE MATERIALS
1. Scheme of Work
2. 9 - Years Basic Education Curriculum
3. Course Book
4. All Relevant Material
5. Online Information -
CONTENT OF THE LESSON
LESSON 1 - INTRODUCTORY ACTIVITIES
SORTING AND CLASSIFYING OBJECTS LEADING TO IDEA OF 6 - 9

- 2 - Rulers - 📏📏

- 4 - Biro - 🖊️🖊️🖊️🖊️
- 5 - Keys - 🔑🔑🔑🔑🔑

IDENTIFICATION OF NUMBERS 6 - 9
Teacher’s Activities - Repeat the previous activities as follows with flash cards number 6 - 9.
Pupil’s Activities - Identify flash cards number 6 - 9.

7 ✏️✏️✏️✏️✏️✏️✏️
8 ✏️✏️✏️✏️✏️✏️✏️✏️
9 ✏️✏️✏️✏️✏️✏️✏️✏️✏️
LESSON 2 - COUNTING AND READING NUMBERS 1 - 9 LOUDLY
Teacher’s/Pupil’s Activities - Present group of objects for the pupils to sort and count, then pick the corresponding flash card number 1 - 9 as follows -
✏️ 1
✏️✏️ 2

✏️✏️✏️✏️✏️✏️✏️✏️✏️ 9
LESSON 2 - READ AND WRITING OF NUMBERS 1 - 9/9 - 1
Teacher’s Activities - Guides pupils to read the numbers 1 - 9 on the flash card or board.
Pupil’s Activities -
Read - 1  2  3  4  5  6  7  8  9
Read - 9  8  7  6  5  4  3  2  1
ORDERING NUMBER 1 - 9/9 - 1
Teacher’s Activities - Asks the pupils to arrange the following cards in order 1 - 9.
6  3  7  9  1  4  8  2  5
Pupil’s Activities -
Order, 1 - 9
1  2  3  4  5  6  7  8  9
Order, 9 - 1
9  8  7  6  5  4  3  2  1
PRESENTATION
To deliver the lesson, the teacher adopts the following steps:
1. To introduce the lesson, the teacher revises the previous lesson. Based on this, he/she asks the pupils some questions;
2. Guides pupils to mix the collection and sort out books, keys, pencils, rulers and biro together.
Pupil’s Activities - Sort and classify the mixed collection e.g. Collection of books, keys, pencils, rulers and biro.
3. Guides pupils to classify each group of similar objects as follows.
- Count out five pencils.
- Add one pencil to it.
4. Leads pupils to recognize this as 6 i.e. 5 pencils and 1 pencil gives 6.
5. Counts out 6 pencils and adds 1 pencil to it and leads them to recognize it as 7 up to 9 buttons etc.
Pupil’s Activities - Identify the numbers 6 - 9 through the activities and the use of Flash cards.
6. Guides pupils to read the numbers 1 - 9.
Pupil’s Activities - Count and read numbers 1 - 9 on the board and Flash cards.
7. Guides pupils to write the numbers 1 - 9.
Pupil’s Activities - Write the numbers 1 - 9.
8. Arranges the numbers in order of their magnitude using objects such as balls, pebbles, etc. in a collection.
9. Leads pupils to write the numbers in order of their magnitudes.
Pupil’s Activities - Use collection of objects to arrange numbers in magnitude or in ordering form.
CONCLUSION
- To conclude the lesson for the week, the teacher revises the entire lesson and links it to the following week’s lesson.
- Next Lesson - Whole Number 10 (Primary 1)
LESSON EVALUATION
Ask pupils to -
1. arrange given number of objects from a collection together.
